references.text: The introduction of the sons of Merari and their clans, which forms the basis for the census described in 4:29.
The result of the census of the sons of Merari as commanded in verse 29, with the total number of men fit for service.
The parallel command to count the sons of Kohath by their clans and families, showing the same pattern for counting the Levites.
The parallel command to count the sons of Gershon by their clans and families, following the same structure.
A later census of the Levites that includes the clan of Merari, demonstrating continuity in the genealogical record.
The original mention of Merari's sons Mahli and Mushi in the genealogy of Levi.
